settings.label: Open reviews
settings.hint: Where a new review opens: beside the chat, or over it in full screen.

profileSettings.label: Spectra Council fixer
profileSettings.hint: Whose agent fixes a review's accepted findings: another profile (say, pi with a different model) in a conversation of its own. None: this conversation's agent.

profileSettings.label: Spectra Council turn limit
profileSettings.hint: How long each turn of a review may take before it gives up: a reviewer's review, the grouping, each round, the proposals and each re-check. A review cut short can still be fetched in once its late reply comes; any other turn cut short just fails.
